threats.title: CERT-In Critical Advisory: Active Exploitation of Edge VPN & Authentication Bypass Flaws in Indian Financial Gateways
threats.entities: Indian Banking Corridors, Payment Gateways & FinTech Core Switches
threats.impact: Unauthenticated perimeter authentication bypass allows remote attackers to compromise internal banking networks. Indian BFSI operators mandated by CERT-In to execute emergency perimeter firmware updates within 24 hours.

threats.title: RBI Cyber Security Directive: Strict 4-Hour Incident Reporting & Cold Fallback Mandate for UPI Switches
threats.ref: RBI Master Direction - IT Governance & Cyber Resilience
threats.entities: Scheduled Commercial Banks, Payment Aggregators & Tier-1 NBFCs
threats.impact: Mandates isolated zero-trust cold fallback architecture for real-time UPI settlement switches. Requires board-level disclosure within 4 hours for any third-party SaaS or API gateway breach.

threats.title: CERT-In Warning: Evasive Android Banking Trojans Targeting 40+ Indian NetBanking & UPI Micro-Lending Apps
threats.entities: Retail NetBanking, NBFC Instant Loan Apps, Mobile Banking
threats.impact: Malicious app overlays abuse Android Accessibility Services to harvest biometric auth bypass tokens and intercept SMS OTPs without user awareness on unpatched mobile devices.

threats.title: DPDP Compliance Audit: Digital Lending NBFCs Probed Over Unencrypted Customer KYC Buckets
threats.entities: NBFC Digital Credit Apps & Third-Party KYC Aggregators
threats.impact: Misconfigured cloud storage buckets exposing Aadhaar/PAN applicant telemetry lead to formal regulatory scrutiny under the Data Protection Board rules with severe financial penalties.

threats.title: NPCI Tech Committee Enforces Hardware FIDO2 & mTLS Corridors Across All Member Bank Settlement Nodes
threats.entities: National Payments Corporation of India & Partner Banks
threats.impact: Eliminates shared credentials and unauthenticated API endpoints across bank switch clearing rails, cutting off automated credential-stuffing and payment replay vectors.

threats.title: Targeted Ransomware Campaign Disables Regional Cooperative Credit Clearing Hubs via Exposed RDP Gateways
threats.sourceName: The Record by Recorded Future & CERT-In
threats.entities: Urban Cooperative Banks & Regional Clearing Centers
threats.impact: Affiliates exploited unmonitored external remote desktop portals lacking MFA, encrypting core banking VMs across three regional cooperative hubs.

threats.title: Binance / BNB Chain Bridge Security Audit: Zero-Day Validator Relay Signature Flaw Neutralized
threats.entities: Binance Ecosystem, BNB Chain Cross-Chain Relayers
threats.impact: Cryptographic signature mismatch vulnerability patched in validator relay contracts before malicious cross-chain drainage; $42M in decentralized bridge liquidity protected.

threats.title: CISA KEV Alert: Actively Exploited PAN-OS Firewall Zero-Day Grants Root Shell Injection to Adversaries
threats.entities: Enterprise Firewalls, Telecommunications & Cloud VPC Perimeters
threats.impact: State-sponsored threat actors weaponizing unauthenticated root command execution to bypass network perimeter defenses. Federal agencies ordered to apply vendor hotfixes immediately.

threats.title: Centralized Exchange Custody Alert: Adversaries Weaponize Stolen Temporary Cloud IAM Tokens in Sweep Scripts
threats.entities: Centralized Crypto Exchanges (CEX), Institutional Custody Hubs
threats.impact: Compromised short-lived AWS IAM metadata tokens used to hijack hot-wallet sweep logic; multi-sig delayed execution thresholds prevented catastrophic capital drain.

threats.title: Global Clearinghouse Backbone Compromised via Third-Party IT Vendor Credential Stuffing
threats.impact: Third-party vendor credentials lacking hardware MFA permitted lateral movement into core payment processing clusters, disrupting claims settlement operations internationally.

threats.title: SEC Enforces First Tier of Penalties on Public Tech Vendors for Concealing Material Ransomware Breaches
threats.ref: SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05 Cyber Disclosure Rule
threats.entities: Public Software Companies, SaaS Providers & Cloud Hosts
threats.impact: Failure to file formal 8-K public disclosures within 4 business days of determining material breach impact triggers formal regulatory sanctions and executive accountability.

threats.title: Malicious PyPI & NPM Cryptography Libraries Exfiltrate Web3 Wallet Seed Phrases to Bulletproof Servers
threats.entities: Web3 Developers, Python Machine Learning Pipelines, DeFi Builders
threats.impact: Typo-squatted packages mimicking popular crypto helper libraries covertly scraped developer local environment files, private keys, and Telegram credentials upon installation.

threats.title: OWASP Warning: Autonomous Agent Host Sandbox Escape via Misconfigured Docker Socket Mounts
threats.sourceName: OWASP GenAI Security Project & NCC Group
threats.entities: Autonomous Coding Agents, Shell AI Assistants, Cloud IDE Runners
threats.impact: Indirect prompt injection inside public GitHub repository READMEs tricks autonomous coding agents into executing host-escaping container commands and leaking host SSH keys.

threats.title: Stealth Weight Poisoning in Safetensors Models Bypasses Automated Open-Source Model Scanners
threats.entities: Open-Source Foundation Models, Hugging Face Hub Repositories
threats.impact: Backdoors injected directly into floating-point weight matrices trigger malicious behavioral overrides only when specific 64-bit hexadecimal seed triggers appear in user prompts.

threats.title: Zero-Width Unicode Characters Exploit Enterprise RAG Assistants to Exfiltrate Confidential M&A Records
threats.entities: Enterprise RAG Pipelines, Slack / Teams AI Integrations
threats.impact: Adversaries embed zero-width invisibles inside routine vendor invoice PDFs; when queried by company RAG systems, the model silently transmits executive summaries to unauthorized endpoints.

threats.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs 2026 Edition: Cross-Session Memory Contamination & Cache Snooping Elevated
threats.entities: Multi-Tenant AI API Gateways, Vector Databases, Semantic Caches
threats.impact: Inadequately keyed semantic caching algorithms return cached outputs containing Tenant A's private financial data in response to semantically similar queries from Tenant B.
